items.source: Return the request Content-Type header if it was parsed successfully, or null otherwise.
items.translation: 如果解析成功，则返回请求的 Content-Type 头；否则返回null。

items.source: Constructor for when the specified Content-Type is invalid.
items.translation: 指定 Content-Type 无效时的构造函数。

items.source: Constructor for when the Content-Type can be parsed but is not supported.
items.translation: 用于 Content-Type 可解析但不受支持的构造器。

items.source: Constructor for when trying to encode from or decode to a specific Java type.
items.translation: 用于尝试从特定 Java 类型编码或解码到该类型的构造函数。

items.source:
Return the list of supported content types in cases when the Content-Type
header is parsed but not supported, or an empty list otherwise.
items.translation: 返回在解析 Content-Type 标头但不支持时支持的媒体类型列表，否则返回空列表。

items.source:
Return the body type in the context of which this exception was generated.
This is applicable when the exception was raised as a result trying to
encode from or decode to a specific Java type.
items.translation: 返回生成此异常上下文的主体类型。当因尝试从特定 Java 类型编码或解码到该类型而抛出此异常时，适用此规则。

items.source: the body type, or null if not available
items.translation: body 类型，或如果不可用则为null

items.source: Exception thrown to indicate that a Content-Type is not supported.
items.translation: 抛出异常以指示不支持的Content-Type。

items.source: Return the body type in the context of which this exception was generated.
items.translation: 返回生成该异常时的 Body 类型。
